description: Data Base Topografico Multiscala - viabilità is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sit.puglia.it. Topographical data base at 1:5,000 and 1:2,000 scales of the entire regional territory. The creation of the regional topographical database follows precise indications defined by the Region State-Local Authorities on Territorial Information Systems, with particular reference to the Specifications for the Production of Geographical Data Bases of general interest. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Data Base Topographic Multiscale — viability" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
